a.lede: The government cited a nationwide communications failure among air traffic control systems as the reason for the sudden grounding on Friday.
a.title: FAA Grounds All US Flights Until Further Notice

b.lede: The FAA determined that a rogue feature in two newly installed routers are to blame for the communications glitches that caused the nationwide ground stop.
b.title: Two HPE Juniper network routers grounded all US flights on Friday
